test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a machine has an efficiency of 80%, it means:

options.text: the machine produces more output than input
the machine loses 20% of the input
the machine has a velocity ratio and mechanical advantage both equal to 80
the machine does not have any loss in input energy

solution:
__**Concept**__

The efficiency of a machine is defined as:

eta={outputover input}times 100

**Explanation:**

If the efficiency is 80%, it means:

 
• 80% of the input energy is converted into useful output.
 
• 20% of the input energy is lost.
